Trimmed real excerpts of the skeyes eAIP (AIP Belgium and Luxembourg),
cycle valid 09 JUL 2026, fetched from
https://ops.skeyes.be/html/belgocontrol_static/eaip/eAIP_Main/.
Each page keeps only the tables the tests pin, wrapped in a minimal
document shell; the AD 2 EBAW page is assembled from its real AD 2.2 /
2.12 / 2.13 / 2.17 / 2.18 / 2.24 sections. pruatlas-firs.json is a
hand-simplified 12-point EBBU ring making the border-stitch pins
deterministic (the production ring lives in public/data).
